---
title: "ARBITER supplementary methods and results"
---

[Download the Word supplement](output/manuscript/Supplement.docx). [TRIPOD-LLM and GRRAS reporting map](output/manuscript/TRIPOD-LLM.docx).

```{r}
# Use the final Word content so the working HTML and Word tables cannot diverge.
body <- system2('quarto',c('pandoc','output/manuscript/Supplement.docx','--to=html','--extract-media=output/supplement-media'),stdout=TRUE)
stopifnot(is.null(attr(body,'status')))
cat(body,sep='\n')
```
